verdict.rationale: Publishing source code under an open license is a fair question for a government digital-services platform like HMRC's online services and APIs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions source repositories, code publication or licensing. The items cover tax registration guidance, Making Tax Digital sign-up, and API and robots.txt probes, none of which concern source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
